import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class Edge {
        int to, capacity, next;
        Edge(int to, int capacity, int next) {
            this.to = to;
            this.capacity = capacity;
            this.next = next;
        }
    }

    static final int[] dx = {-1, 1, 0, 0};
    static final int[] dy = {0, 0, -1, 1};
    static final int MAXN = 20;
    static final int MAX_NODES = 1000;
    static final int MAX_EDGES = 1000000;

    static Edge[] edges = new Edge[MAX_EDGES];
    static int[] head = new int[MAX_NODES];
    static int edge_idx = 1;

    static int S, T, n, t, INF;
    static int[][] dist = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[][] depth = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[][] node_id = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[][] sink_node = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[] queue_bfs = new int[MAX_NODES * 1000];
    static int[] queue_dinic = new int[MAX_NODES];
    static int[] depth_dinic = new int[MAX_NODES];

    static char[][] grid1 = new char[MAXN][MAXN];
    static char[][] grid2 = new char[MAXN][MAXN];

    static void insert_edge(int u, int v, int cap) {
        edges[++edge_idx] = new Edge(v, cap, head[u]);
        head[u] = edge_idx;
        
        edges[++edge_idx] = new Edge(u, 0, head[v]);
        head[v] = edge_idx;
    }

    static void bfs_propagate(int sx, int sy, boolean mode) {
        int front = 0, rear = 0;
        queue_bfs[rear++] = sx * 1000 + sy;
        
        for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(dist[i], 0x3f3f3f3f);
        }
        INF = dist[0][0];
        dist[sx][sy] = 0;
        
        while (front < rear) {
            int cur = queue_bfs[front++];
            int x = cur / 1000;
            int y = cur % 1000;
            
            if (mode && sink_node[x][y] != 0 && dist[x][y] <= t && dist[x][y] <= depth[x][y]) {
                insert_edge(node_id[x][y], sink_node[x][y], INF);
            }
            
            if (dist[x][y] > t || dist[x][y] >= depth[x][y]) continue;
            
            if (node_id[x][y] == 3 && sink_node[x][y] == 9) {
                System.out.println(dist[x][y]);
            }
            
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i) {
                int nx = x + dx[i];
                int ny = y + dy[i];
                if (nx >= 1 && nx <= n && ny >= 1 && ny <= n && Character.isDigit(grid1[nx][ny]) && dist[nx][ny] == INF) {
                    dist[nx][ny] = dist[x][y] + 1;
                    queue_bfs[rear++] = nx * 1000 + ny;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static boolean build_level_graph() {
        Arrays.fill(depth_dinic, 0);
        int front = 0, rear = 0;
        queue_dinic[rear++] = S;
        depth_dinic[S] = 1;
        
        while (front < rear) {
            int u = queue_dinic[front++];
            for (int e = head[u]; e != 0; e = edges[e].next) {
                int v = edges[e].to;
                if (depth_dinic[v] != 0 || edges[e].capacity == 0) continue;
                depth_dinic[v] = depth_dinic[u] + 1;
                queue_dinic[rear++] = v;
                if (v == T) return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    static int dfs_dinic(int u, int flow_limit) {
        if (u == T) return flow_limit;
        int total_pushed = 0;
        
        for (int e = head[u]; e != 0 && flow_limit > 0; e = edges[e].next) {
            int v = edges[e].to;
            if (depth_dinic[v] != depth_dinic[u] + 1 || edges[e].capacity == 0) continue;
            
            int pushed = dfs_dinic(v, Math.min(flow_limit, edges[e].capacity));
            if (pushed > 0) {
                edges[e].capacity -= pushed;
                edges[e ^ 1].capacity += pushed;
                total_pushed += pushed;
                flow_limit -= pushed;
            }
        }
        
        if (total_pushed == 0) depth_dinic[u] = -1;
        return total_pushed;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        
        int n_val = sc.nextInt();
        int t_val = sc.nextInt();
        n = n_val;
        t = t_val;
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            String line = sc.next();
            grid1[i] = line.toCharArray();
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            String line = sc.next();
            grid2[i] = line.toCharArray();
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(depth[i], 0x3f3f3f3f);
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
                if (grid1[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    bfs_propagate(i, j, false);
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; i++) {
            System.arraycopy(dist[i], 0, depth[i], 0, MAXN);
        }
        
        int node_counter = 1;
        S = 0;
        T = 1;
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
                if (grid1[i][j] > '0' && grid1[i][j] <= '9') {
                    node_id[i][j] = ++node_counter;
                    insert_edge(S, node_id[i][j], grid1[i][j] - '0');
                }
                if (grid2[i][j] > '0' && grid2[i][j] <= '9') {
                    sink_node[i][j] = ++node_counter;
                    insert_edge(sink_node[i][j], T, grid2[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
                if (node_id[i][j] != 0) {
                    bfs_propagate(i, j, true);
                }
            }
        }
        
        int max_flow = 0;
        while (build_level_graph()) {
            max_flow += dfs_dinic(S, INF);
        }
        
        System.out.println(max_flow);
        sc.close();
    }
}
